lessons.lesson_title_en: Lesson 4-1: Types and Characteristics of Media

definitions.current_definition_en: Communication from sender to receiver only.
definitions.updated_definition_en: Communication from sender to receiver only.

definitions.current_definition_en: Communication in which users can respond and share.
definitions.updated_definition_en: Communication in which users can respond and share.

lessons.lesson_title_en: Lesson 4-2: Information Design and User Experience for Websites
lessons.lesson_title_ar: الدرس الثاني: تصميم المعلومات وتجربة المستخدم للمواقع الإلكترونية

definitions.current_definition_en: A typical user image of those who will use the website, set up as a concrete person. Details such as age, occupation, purpose, and challenges are selected.
definitions.updated_definition_en: A typical user image of those who will use the website, set up as a concrete person. Details such as age, occupation, purpose, and challenges are selected.

definitions.current_definition_en: A rough blueprint of the layout of a web page. It does not include color or design decoration and is created to determine the placement and priority of information.
definitions.updated_definition_en: A rough blueprint of the layout of a web page. It does not include color or design decoration and is created to determine the placement and priority of information.

definitions.current_definition_en: Contrast, Repetition, Alignment, and Proximity: four principles followed by designs that are easy to view and understand.
definitions.updated_definition_en: Contrast, Repetition, Alignment, and Proximity: four principles followed by designs that are easy to view and understand.

definitions.current_definition_en: Make the priority of information clear and immediately highlight the most important elements.
definitions.updated_definition_en: Make the priority of information clear and immediately highlight the most important elements.

definitions.current_definition_en: Repeat specific characteristics so that the whole design has consistency, allowing users to navigate without getting lost.
definitions.updated_definition_en: Repeat specific characteristics so that the whole design has consistency, allowing users to navigate without getting lost.

definitions.current_definition_en: Align the position of each element to a common baseline, giving order to the entire screen.
definitions.updated_definition_en: Align the position of each element to a common baseline, giving order to the entire screen.

definitions.current_definition_en: Place related information close together so that it can be perceived as a single group at a glance.
definitions.updated_definition_en: Place related information close together so that it can be perceived as a single group at a glance.

definitions.current_definition_en: A design approach that designs websites and services from the perspective of the user, rather than the convenience of the creator.
definitions.updated_definition_en: A design approach that designs websites and services from the perspective of the user, rather than the convenience of the creator.

definitions.current_definition_en: How easily users can navigate a website and achieve their goals.
definitions.updated_definition_en: How easily users can navigate a website and achieve their goals.

definitions.current_definition_en: Designing content and interfaces so that people with disabilities can use and interact with the website.
definitions.updated_definition_en: Designing content and interfaces so that people with disabilities can use and interact with the website.

lessons.lesson_title_ar: الدرس الثالث: طرق تقييم المواقع الإلكترونية

definitions.current_definition_en: Explores in depth the reasons behind users’ psychology and behavior and evaluates qualitative aspects that cannot be expressed in numbers.
definitions.updated_definition_en: Explores in depth the reasons behind users’ psychology and behavior and evaluates qualitative aspects that cannot be expressed in numbers.

definitions.current_definition_en: Uses numerical data such as access counts and time and evaluates the current state objectively and statistically.
definitions.updated_definition_en: Uses numerical data such as access counts and time and evaluates the current state objectively and statistically.

definitions.current_definition_en: Observing actual user operations to identify points that are hard to use.
definitions.updated_definition_en: Observing actual user operations to identify points that are hard to use.

definitions.current_definition_en: Hearing users’ direct voices to understand their needs and dissatisfactions.
definitions.updated_definition_en: Hearing users’ direct voices to understand their needs and dissatisfactions.

definitions.current_definition_en: A technique for analyzing how a website is accessed using numerical values.
definitions.updated_definition_en: A technique for analyzing how a website is accessed using numerical values.

definitions.current_definition_en: The total number of times a page has been viewed.
definitions.updated_definition_en: The total number of times a page has been viewed.

definitions.current_definition_en: The proportion of visits that ended after viewing only the first page.
definitions.updated_definition_en: The proportion of visits that ended after viewing only the first page.

definitions.current_definition_en: The proportion of visits that achieved a target action (purchase, registration, etc.).
definitions.updated_definition_en: The proportion of visits that achieved a target action (purchase, registration, etc.).

definitions.current_definition_en: A method in which experts identify problems in a website’s user interface based on rules of thumb (heuristics).
definitions.updated_definition_en: A method in which experts identify problems in a website’s user interface based on rules of thumb (heuristics).

definitions.current_definition_en: Whether the design and operations are unified across the site.
definitions.updated_definition_en: Whether the design and operations are unified across the site.

definitions.current_definition_en: Whether the design makes it hard for users to make mistakes.
definitions.updated_definition_en: Whether the design makes it hard for users to make mistakes.

definitions.current_definition_en: Whether system status is clearly indicated to users (e.g., processing indicators, input error messages).
definitions.updated_definition_en: Whether system status is clearly indicated to users (e.g., processing indicators, input error messages).

lessons.lesson_title_en: Lesson 4-4: The Iterative Improvement Process for Websites
lessons.lesson_title_ar: الدرس الرابع: عملية التحسين التكراري للمواقع

definitions.current_definition_en: A method that continuously advances improvement by repeating four steps: Plan, Do, Check, Act.
definitions.updated_definition_en: A method that continuously advances improvement by repeating four steps: Plan, Do, Check, Act.

definitions.current_definition_en: Getting better a little at a time.
definitions.updated_definition_en: Getting better a little at a time.

definitions.current_definition_en: A way of thinking that leads to discovering problems and generating solutions from the perspective of the user.
definitions.updated_definition_en: A way of thinking that leads to discovering problems and generating solutions from the perspective of the user.

definitions.current_definition_en: A method in which two patterns (option A and option B) are prepared, each is shown to actual users, and data is examined to determine which is more effective.
definitions.updated_definition_en: A method in which two patterns (option A and option B) are prepared, each is shown to actual users, and data is examined to determine which is more effective.
